turns.question: How much did a lead from search campaigns cost us in early October 2026?
turns.answer: A lead from search campaigns cost EUR 46.00 (total search ad spend over total search leads) over 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-10, which I took as "early October". Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
